description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mampe, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521202
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration, specifically the declaration of determination for parcels of land (Nos. 340 and 341) in Colombo District under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner information, title class, and encumbrances. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and deals with land registration matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
